title: malaxis purpurea
intro: Malaxis purpurea, commonly known as Purple Malaxis or Purple Adder's-mouth Orchid, is a terrestrial orchid species found in tropical and subtropical regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Malaxis purpurea include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and aid in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Malaxis purpurea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
